plainText:
Rock-A-Bye Pokémon (Part 2) (Japanese: アーモンドを救え！！ (後編) Save Almond! (Part 2)), is the seventh chapter of the seventh volume of Magical Pokémon Journey.

==Plot==
 
Hazel and Coconut find that the source of Almond's deep sleep is a pair of prankster Pokémon, and . They've put him to sleep and are eating his dreams! What's more, he's having romantic dreams, and so the two are eating his will to love as well!

==Important characters and Pokémon==
Hazel
Coconut
